summary: Preserved candidate PR 3289's attention-TP padding prediction and eager fail-closed validation, independently reproduced review PR 3315's actual draft-v2 planner counterexample at exact commit 43c2db023064dfbfe823e0147be6b47d3fc06f2b, then made the planner zero-pad the expanded sequence lengths used by top-k and DeepGEMM scheduling while accepting the intentionally absent prefill-only indexer metadata.

tests.what_was_measured: On the exact candidate, real planner helpers produced four padded DSA cache rows, three expanded rows, and no indexer ranges/token-to-batch map; the candidate validator rejected that state.

14 focused tests passed, including GPU three-to-four-row attention-TP padding and the corrected draft-v2 contract where expanded/schedule/KV extents cover four physical rows while prefill-only indexer fields remain absent.

gpu_execution.evidence: Planner padding and the exact counterexample ran on AMD Instinct MI350X with ROCm 7.2.26015.

remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek DSA model weights or qualified end-to-end speculative DSA fixture were available. Therefore full model-level attention, indexer kernel, DeepGEMM schedule execution, top-k transform, and KV-write numerics remain unverified. The supplied tiny Llama fixture is a different architecture and was not used as substitute evidence. No C++ or FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable; CUDA-only and distributed variants were not exercised.
